summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for restaurant labor productivity and kitchen operating automation. The strongest direct equipment exposure is Middleby, with ITW as a large-cap reference anchor. The underfollowed lane includes PAR Technology for restaurant operating software/POS and TransAct Technologies as a speculative micro-cap back-of-house automation and food-safety workflow vendor. The main chokepoint hypothesis remains that chain-approved equipment, installed bases, serviceability, and workflow integration may matter more than futuristic restaurant robotics.
